## `protocol.ts` freeze declared · #25467 E2 section 1 (metadata reads) · 2026-11-02T17:14Z

Ruling E (6537939895) makes each E2 cut on a declared freeze day. Effective now, until the section-1 PRs merge (at most until 06:00 UTC tomorrow, whichever comes first; extended here if needed).

- **Frozen:** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`. Other PRs touching it queue behind the cut: they may stay open but don't push to that file or merge.
- **The cut:** lines ~3851–7057, `readItemFromMetadataService` … `getUiView`. 13 member bodies move through the host into `protocol-meta-*.ts` modules. Declarations stay on the class as stubs, so the `.d.ts` bar holds.
- **Known open PR on the file:** #29456 (spec lane; its hunks are outside the section). It queues behind the cut, then merges main.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-xniw22`, `Part of #25467`.

A lifting note follows here when the cut lands.
